section.title: Customer search
section.question: What vulnerability does this search action have, and how would you fix it?

answers.complete: params[:q] is interpolated straight into the SQL string, so it is SQL injection. A search like ' OR 1=1 OR name LIKE ' closes the quote and changes the query, and a UNION could read columns from other tables. Pass the value as a bound parameter and escape the LIKE wildcards: current_account.customers.where("name LIKE ?", "%#{Customer.sanitize_sql_like(params[:q].to_s)}%").limit(25).
answers.partial: This is SQL injection, because the search text goes straight into the query string. Someone could type SQL into the search box.
answers.miss: The search has no pagination beyond limit(25), and LIKE with a leading wildcard can't use an index, so it will be slow on big accounts. Add a trigram index.
